item.stem:
The diagram shows $\triangle ABC$ with a right angle at $B$, $AB=5$, and $BC=12$. Vihaan wants the length of $AC$.

Which claim correctly applies $a^{2}+b^{2}=c^{2}$?

options.A: $AC$ is the hypotenuse opposite the right angle, so $5^{2}+12^{2}=AC^{2}$ and $AC=13$.
options.B: Apply $5^{2}+12^{2}=AC^{2}$ even when the right-angle mark at $B$ is removed.
options.C: The right angle at $B$ is produced only after $5^{2}+12^{2}=AC^{2}$ is written.
options.D: Treat $AC$ as a leg and set $AC^{2}+5^{2}=12^{2}$.
